controls.title: Authentication mode posture
controls.requirement: Support and enforce token-mode bearer authentication on protected API paths.
controls.finding: Token-mode bearer verification is enabled at web-server startup and post-flash runtime probes confirm deterministic 401 responses on protected routes without bearer token.

controls.title: Authorization scope enforcement
controls.requirement: Enforce minimum scopes for control-plane endpoints.
controls.finding: Per-route scope checks are enforced (`files:read/write`, `ebin:manage`) before handler execution; post-flash runtime probe confirms deterministic 403 on insufficient-scope token.

controls.title: SD-card allowlist roots
controls.requirement: File endpoints must enforce SD allowlist roots.
controls.finding: `/api/v2/files/*` handlers enforce canonical SD allowlist roots including staging and ebin directories; post-flash runtime probe confirms outside-root rejection with `PATH_NOT_ALLOWED`.

controls.title: Path normalization/traversal prevention
controls.requirement: Normalize and validate file paths to prevent traversal.
controls.finding: Canonicalization and traversal rejection are applied to list/upload/move/delete/download/mkdir/stat path inputs; post-flash runtime probe confirms traversal and mixed-separator rejection.

controls.title: Upload size bound enforcement
controls.requirement: Reject request bodies exceeding configured handler bounds.
controls.finding: Current JSON upload path rejects oversized bodies when `content_len >= out_buf_size` and fails request parsing.

controls.title: Upload chunk timeout controls
controls.requirement: Enforce chunk timeout controls for remote uploads.
controls.finding: Upload endpoint supports staged sessions under `/sdcard/.staging` with max chunk size, per-chunk timeout, and explicit commit gate to canonical target path; post-flash runtime probe confirms 202/413/408 staged behavior.

controls.title: EBIN integrity gates before load
controls.requirement: Validate hash/signature/ABI/dependency constraints before successful load.
controls.finding: EBIN validate and load flows enforce deterministic integrity gates and reject invalid modules.

controls.title: Audit-log event completeness
controls.requirement: Maintain audit log for uploads, loads/unloads, validation failures, and session transitions.
controls.finding: Persistent append-only JSONL audit sink on SD (`/sdcard/ebins/esptari_audit.jsonl`) records upload/load/unload/validate-failure/session-transition events with actor/action/target/status/timestamp/reason; post-flash runtime paths are verified reachable.
